original.target_description: Verified original title: Mechanisms of Selective Attention in Generalized Anxiety Disorder. Revisited supplied locator p. 6 in the available author manuscript. That page contains Experiment 1 measures, attentional-task materials and procedure, with no target inferential test. The adjacent results on manuscript pp. 7–8 contain multiple different Group × Valence, within-GAD valence and pairwise contrasts. The broad description and page-only locator do not uniquely identify the intended outcome/sample/test; pagination of a different version is not established.

replication.target_description: Likely-GAD subgroup main effect of face valence on reaction times, follow-up ANOVA at p.726. Source identifies faster angry-versus-neutral responses in GAD as the specific replication claim; no numeric pairwise statistic is printed.

n.sample_role: participants meeting likely GAD criteria, subgroup used in face-valence follow-up
n.exclusions: From 139 tested, 6 excluded for incomplete/missing data; 133 retained overall (63 GAD, 29 HTA, 41 control). Incorrect responses and time outlier trials excluded.
